body:
## Pull request overview

Improves mobile UX for modal forms by making dialogs full-screen on small screens, restructuring ModalForm layout to better use vertical space, updating form grid breakpoints to avoid multi-column layouts on phones, and adding tests/roadmap updates to reflect the UX work.

**Changes:**
- Update DialogContent to be full-screen on mobile and increase close-button touch target.
- Refactor ModalForm container layout (flex column + scrollable body) and switch loading UI to Skeletons.
- Adjust form renderer grid breakpoints so multi-column layouts start at `md`/`lg`/`xl` instead of `sm`, and add a new MobileUX test file.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 3 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| pnpm-lock.yaml | Regenerated lockfile; notably removes hotcrm workspace importers. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/MobileUX.test.tsx | Adds tests intended to cover the new mobile modal UX behaviors. |
| packages/plugin-form/src/ModalForm.tsx | Switches to skeleton loading UI and flex-based dialog layout with a scrollable body. |
| packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx | Alters DialogContent mobile positioning/sizing and close button sizing. |
| packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx | Shifts responsive grid breakpoints to enforce single-column on mobile. |
| ROADMAP.md | Marks mobile dialog/form UX items as completed. |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (1)</summary>

**pnpm-lock.yaml:588**
* pnpm-workspace.yaml includes `examples/hotcrm/packages/*` as workspace importers, but this lockfile change removes all `examples/hotcrm/packages/...` importers. With CI/Vercel using `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, this will break installs when the hotcrm submodule is checked out. Regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml with the hotcrm submodule initialized so those importers are present.
</details>

This file is under `packages/components/src/ui/**` (Shadcn sync/no-touch zone). Modifying it directly risks being overwritten by upstream sync scripts and violates the repo convention to wrap primitives in `packages/components/src/custom/*` instead. Please revert these direct edits and implement the mobile/fullscreen + touch-target changes in a wrapper (or custom DialogContent variant) that composes the upstream primitive.

The new ModalForm layout makes the body (`flex-1 overflow-y-auto ...`) the only scroll container, but the submit/cancel buttons are rendered inside the form renderer (inside `renderContent()`), so they will scroll out of view and are not a sticky footer. This conflicts with the PR goal/ROADMAP item “sticky action buttons at bottom”. Consider rendering actions in a dedicated footer outside the scroll area (e.g., hide form actions and render a sticky footer in ModalForm) so primary actions remain visible on mobile.

These tests describe validating full-screen mobile behavior and touch-target sizing, but they only assert presence of `flex`/`flex-col` and that a close button exists. Since the PR changes rely on specific classes (`h-[100dvh]`, `min-h/[44px]`, `min-w/[44px]`, etc.), add assertions that those classes are applied so regressions are caught.

Reverted `dialog.tsx` to the upstream Shadcn state and moved mobile optimizations to a new `MobileDialogContent` custom wrapper at `packages/components/src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx`. ModalForm now imports `MobileDialogContent` instead of `DialogContent`. Fixed in `c735971`.

Implemented a proper sticky footer. The inner form renderer now receives `showActions: false` + `id: formId` (via React `useId()`). Action buttons are rendered in a dedicated `shrink-0 border-t` footer div *outside* the scroll area. The external submit button uses the HTML `form={formId}` attribute to link to the form element. Fixed in `c735971` and `32be655`.

Strengthened all assertions: tests now explicitly check for `h-[100dvh]`, `min-h-[44px]`, `min-w-[44px]` classes. Added two new tests — one verifying the sticky footer contains action buttons as a sibling to the scroll area, and one verifying footer is hidden during loading. Fixed in `c735971`.
